I write about programming languages, type theory, and proof assistants —
mostly through the lens of [OCaml](https://ocaml.org) and
[Lean](https://lean-lang.org).

This blog is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published from
[its source](https://github.com/enetsee/enetsee.github.io).
